trigger: Long sessions and cached metadata can create false confidence in context safety
expected_behavior: Verified live occupancy triggers a durable fresh-session handoff before excessive context growth
observed_behavior: Isolated H0b runtime emitted cumulative total and latest-request usage; current-chat A/U/C remain unverified. A single sentinel isolation and immediate interrupt trial passed.
impact: Risk of degraded reasoning, expensive usage and unreliable project state
evidence: codex app-server daemon version: missing default control socket
Desktop read_thread: no live model/context counters
H0 2026-10-27: harness/logs/build-log.md, versioned schema and isolated zero-turn probe
H0b bounded live events: total 32614 versus last 16332 after two turns; see build log

root_cause.hypothesis: Reliance on prompt self-monitoring or cached capacity cannot enforce live thresholds
root_cause.confidence: high for telemetry limitation; prior-session causal mechanism unverified

recurrence: User reports multiple prior sessions; no numeric count inferred
prevention: Use bounded manual fresh-session packets now; validate an external controller and measurement semantics before claiming automation

validation.method: Bounded three-turn inference plus immediate interrupt in separate ephemeral threads
validation.result: Cumulative/latest distinction observed; sentinel recall/isolation and 30 ms immediate cancellation passed
validation.limitations: No usable-capacity/retained-context semantics, general memory-isolation guarantee, ongoing-generation interruption or worst-case bound

trigger: Disposable integration tests must avoid implicit persistent volumes and stale containers.
expected_behavior: Only test-owned ephemeral data/resources are created and removed.
observed_behavior: PostgreSQL 18 image uses /var/lib/postgresql; overriding that root with tmpfs and verifying UUID ownership/removal left container and volume inventories empty across two three-case runs.
impact: Repeatable real relational tests without touching existing data.

root_cause.hypothesis: Image-declared volumes must be explicitly overridden at the correct version-specific mount root.

recurrence: Two bounded runs; no generalized crash-recovery claim.
prevention: Pin image digest, inspect volume semantics, require rootless runtime, scope cleanup by unique ownership, and verify absence on success and exception paths.

validation.method: Real Podman/PostgreSQL tests plus before/after container and volume inventory
validation.limitations: Host crash, forced kill and runtime disconnection not tested

trigger: A local host must avoid persistent/global cookie-key side effects.
expected_behavior: Ephemeral cookie protection never writes key material to the user profile.
observed_behavior: UseEphemeralDataProtectionProvider selected ephemeral ticket protection, but framework key-management warmup still generated a user-profile XML key. Configuring the key-management XML repository in memory too prevented further writes in subsequent real host tests; the exact test-created key was removed.
impact: An apparently ephemeral host can create unintended global key state.

root_cause.hypothesis: Cookie IDataProtectionProvider selection does not disable the independent key-management warmup repository.
root_cause.confidence: high for ASP.NET Core 10.0.14 behavior observed here

recurrence: One initial startup incident; subsequent corrected test runs and direct inventory were clean.
prevention: Configure both provider and startup key repository for the intended persistence boundary; inspect real startup logs and filesystem side effects.

validation.method: Real API startup/PTY tests, captured startup logs and exact key-directory inventory
validation.result: Corrected host uses memory-only provider/repository; identified test-created key removed.
validation.limitations: Local pilot only; durable production key storage still requires review.

trigger: An outer browser runner owns a nested test process and its disposable database.
expected_behavior: Outer teardown waits until the inner fixture finishes verified resource cleanup.
observed_behavior: Polling HTTP listener shutdown allowed Playwright to kill dotnet test before DisposablePostgres finally completed, leaving four owned containers. A per-run post-cleanup marker awaited by global teardown fixed the successful-run lifecycle; final inventories were empty.
impact: Browser assertions can pass while disposable database processes remain running.

root_cause.hypothesis: Listener shutdown is earlier than nested asynchronous database cleanup; outer process termination races finally.

recurrence: Four initial browser runs left one owned container each before final inventory exposed the pattern.
prevention: Require explicit cleanup-complete acknowledgement from resource owner before terminating nested processes; inspect actual inventories independently of test assertions.

validation.method: Real Chromium/API/PostgreSQL run, completion marker and final process/container/volume inventory
validation.result: Final 6/6 browser tests passed with zero containers/volumes/processes/markers/zoom profiles remaining.
validation.limitations: Forced kill, host crash and unavailable runtime remain untested; manual exact-owner recovery required.

trigger: Functional and responsive verification can be mistaken for visual-design acceptance.
expected_behavior: Assess hierarchy, clarity, cohesion and user preference before calling a UI polished or expanding its design across features.
observed_behavior: I1b functional/viewport/contrast tests passed, but user rejected the interface as cluttered, unclear and lacking harmony, and rejected green accents.
impact: An unaccepted visual foundation becomes more expensive to correct as feature count grows.

root_cause.hypothesis: Implementation and measurement coverage were prioritized without enough design-quality review with the user.
root_cause.confidence: high for acceptance gap; not a quantified causal study

recurrence: One explicit user rejection of the initial I1b design.
prevention: Agree on a cohesive visual direction and representative layouts, review actual screens with the user, then implement/verify across widths; keep functional checks distinct from design approval.

validation.result: Redesign implemented; agent inspected actual templates and corrected mobile header/hover transition; user visual acceptance remains pending.
validation.limitations: No claim that automated metrics predict aesthetic quality.
